text: I'll start with the first source.

**image-A.png:** A single filled circle, slightly left of and above center, on a plain light background. The color is a saturated, pure-looking red (close to #FF0000), flat with no gradient or shading. Below the circle, near the bottom edge, there is printed black text reading **"A17"** in a simple sans-serif, roughly centered horizontally but positioned toward the lower-middle. No other marks, borders, or text are visible.

Now the second source.

**image-B.png:** A solid filled square (not a circle), centered horizontally and positioned in the upper-middle area, with sharp right-angle corners. The color is a strong, vivid blue (close to #0000FF), flat and uniform. Below the square, printed black text reads **"B28"**, in a plain sans-serif similar in size and style to the previous label, horizontally centered near the lower portion. Background is plain light/white; nothing else is visible.

Now the third source.

**image-C.png:** A filled upward-pointing triangle with a sharp apex at top and a horizontal flat base, centered horizontally and occupying the middle of the frame. The color is a medium-dark saturated green (close to #008000), flat and unshaded. Below it, black printed text reads **"C39"**, same sans-serif styling as the other labels, centered near the bottom. Plain light background; no other elements.

## Comparison

1. **Shape:** Each source shows one solid geometric figure — a circle (A), a square (B), an upward triangle (C). All are filled shapes with no outlines, shading, or gradients, placed centrally on a plain light field.

2. **Color:** The fills are distinctly different hues: pure saturated red (A), vivid blue (B), and a darker forest green (C). Each is flat and uniform across the shape.

3. **Printed text:** Each carries one black sans-serif label beneath the shape — "A17", "B28", and "C39" respectively — all centered near the bottom and rendered at comparable size and style.

The three images form a matched set varying only in shape, color, and label; all share the same layout and background.
